central_invariant: Inside networkless Docker broker, a trusted-host admin revocation may be committed only if a separate pinned Ed25519 TEST administrator key signs an exact frozen request-bound, zero-spend, no-bank-effect, time-bounded command. Its nonce and command digest are durably consumed atomically with the request revocation in one SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction. All later AF_UNIX mock dispatch claims are denied.
scope: synthetic Task15 offline mock + TEST signer; never real Provider
admin_root_enrollment: The trusted CI host generates and pins the independent admin TEST root. It is NOT an independently verified organization operator or production IAM identity.
signature: TEST Ed25519 over sorted compact canonical UTF-8 JSON; 256-bit nonce; max 300 seconds validity
serialized_admin_action: Insert signed admin command nonce, insert revocation, append revocation audit and signed admin audit within one SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE write transaction; replay and second fresh revoke fail closed
expected_scenarios: revocation_first: signed action commits before valid copied worker key+grant, zero mock effect
claim_first: a previously permitted synthetic effect may happen before signed revocation, followed by denial of all new dispatch
limitations: The admin key is a locally generated TEST key; there is no independent trusted human enrollment or multi-party approval
Privileged Docker host can supply/replace the admin-root CLI argument or edit private SQLite; those capabilities are trusted
A stolen signed admin authorization may execute once before expiry if it has not yet been durably consumed
Revocation cannot undo a claim already committed or local effect already made
The request is identifier-only; no complete native AgentDojo wire authenticity or real Provider secret custody
No API HTTP transport or bank effect enabled
